opinions.text: D. C. S. D. Tex. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 515 U. S. 1172.] Motions of the Solicitor General and the state and private appellants for divided argument granted in part, and the time is divided as follows: state appellants, 20 minutes; private appellants, 10 minutes; the Solicitor General, 10 minutes; and appellees, 40 minutes.
